  • Field Details

    • ATRIUM

      public static final String[] ATRIUM
      The Atrium of 7800: the hub at depth 0. The adventurer starts here, the up staircase at the bottom leads back to the surface, and the down staircase in the east alcove leads into the Halls. The side rooms are reserved for the hub's residents.

    • SANCTUM

      public static final String[] SANCTUM
      The Sanctum at the bottom of the Halls: a pillared hall edged by chasms, with the Diploma's altar in the north alcove. There is no down staircase.

    • ORIENTATION

      public static final String[] ORIENTATION
      Orientation: the tutorial floor. Five rooms in a row teach movement, doors, items, combat, traps and searching (the last room is behind a secret door), ending at a down staircase.
